text:
Type: table
Name: Ameriwood Home Franklin Coffee Table, Black
Colors: Black
Materials: Engineered Wood
Get the table space you need in your living room with the Ameriwood Home Franklin Coffee Table Made of painted MDF and solid wood legs, the black finish gives the Table a modern feel Place remotes and electronics on the table top and keep books, magazines, or extra throws on the lower open shelf. The 2 drawers are perfect for small items and keep your table top free from clutter Finish your space with the entire Franklin collection (sold separately) The Table ships flat to your door and 2 adults are recommended to assemble. The table top can hold 75 lbs. and the lower shelf will hold 20 lbs. The drawers can hold up to 15 lbs. each. Assembled dimensions: 18.5”H x 41.14”W x 20.6”D
